title: Self-service Website & Sales Flow Builder
headline: Replacing weeks of custom development with the tools to build and launch on their own

overview.headline: Moving repeated website and funnel work into a shared self-service builder

intro: A self-service builder for partner brands to create landing pages, quizzes, promotions, and sales flows from reusable components styled with their own branding.
Brands shared similar sales journeys but differed in identity, content, and experiments. Supporting those variations through custom development made launches slow and hard to scale.

image.alt: Website builder with reusable components, a page preview, and configuration settings.

sections.label: ROLE & SCOPE
sections.headline: Designing both the builder and the system behind it
paragraphs: I designed the core experience across page building, quizzes, templates, branding, promotions, and reusable components. My work included defining feature behavior, structuring configuration flows, and turning complex editing needs into consistent UX patterns.

sections.label: PROBLEM
sections.headline: Similar sales journeys were rebuilt for every brand
paragraphs: Partner brands often followed the same core sales pattern: attract customers, understand their needs through a quiz, recommend a relevant product, and move them toward purchase. But each brand wanted its own identity, content, offers, and experiments. Supporting those variations through custom development meant even relatively small changes could take weeks to launch.

items.title: Shared sales journey
items.text: Landing pages, quizzes, recommendations, and purchase flows followed a similar core structure, but were still rebuilt or adapted for each brand.

items.title: Brand-specific variations
items.text: Each company needed its own visual style, messaging, imagery, and tone. Teams also wanted to adapt content, page structure, offers, and sales flows to fit their own approach.

items.title: Developer dependency
items.text: Changes and experiments often required engineering work instead of simple configuration.

items.title: Weeks to launch
items.text: Even relatively small experiments could take weeks to implement and release.

sections.label: SYSTEM STRATEGY
sections.headline: Standardizing the shared flow while keeping each brand flexible
paragraphs: The goal was not to make every brand use the same website. We identified the parts of the sales journey that repeated across companies, turned them into reusable building blocks, and kept the content, branding, and configuration flexible enough for each team to adapt.

items.title: Shared sales structure
items.description: Reuse common patterns across landing pages, quizzes, product recommendations, and purchase flows.

image.alt: Reusable landing page templates and sales flow patterns.

items.title: Brand-level styling
items.description: Define logos, typography, and colors once so new pages and components automatically follow the brand’s visual identity.

image.alt: Brand configuration for logos, typography, and colors with a live preview.

items.title: Configurable building blocks
items.description: Let teams adapt content, layout, settings, and component behavior without rebuilding the experience from scratch.
